ProjectionRace.scope: The existing fail-closed helper and its published unsupported capability, versus a rejected future read-check-unconditional-replace design. The helper has no product caller in the reviewed tree. Existing explicit authoring writers have their own matching/review protocol and are not modeled here.
excluded: Explicit manual authoring writer protocol and all-writer guard coverage

UpdateCommit.scope: A single already-authorized selection write, two exact resource identities, two selected revisions and one existing session. Prepare/commit ordering contract, not a refinement proof of all current mutation dispatches.

AuditRun.scope: Two surviving Skill roots, one orphan visible only to reverse inventory, one changed body, a one-Skill slice budget and up to two resumptions. The reverse scan abstracts paginated inventory, not its HTTP cost. Existing observation and body-write reconciliation use read-only reconcile mode, not automatic repair. The observer's readOnly regression covers only the separate new-adoption stop.
excluded: unknown historical data absent from every retained index

implemented_boundary.scope: The new read-only transport restricts descendant helpers, including legacy Notion requests, before the request scheduler. Current state inspection uses this boundary; this does not implement AuditRun inventory, budgets, checkpoints, or full coverage.

review_basis: Reviewed product base and exact working-tree hashes. NR01/NR02 additions require their own public and live acceptance; these models do not establish completion.
